title: Minimal geometric points and points of the underlying infinity-topos
statement_scope: Whole Proposition 1.1.15: let X = (X, O_X) be a spectral Deligne-Mumford stack. The construction (eta: X_0 -> X) mapsto (eta* in Fun(X,S)) determines an equivalence from the infinity-category GPt(X) of minimal geometric points of X to the subcategory of Fun(X,S) whose objects preserve small colimits and finite limits and whose morphisms are equivalences.

standard_prerequisites: Infinity-topos theory, geometric morphisms, and Proposition T.6.3.5.5 in Lurie, Higher Topos Theory.
Compatible affine coverings/colimits of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks, Lemma V.2.3.11 in DAG V.
Strictly Henselian E-infinity rings, Ind-étale A-algebras, and Corollary 1.1.7 (author PDF p. 7).
Separable closures of residue fields and Henselization (author PDF pp. 7-9).
difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: H3 because the complete proof at author PDF pp. 8-9 supplies a substantial research-bearing construction, not a routine citation: it reduces an arbitrary spectral Deligne-Mumford stack to the affine case via a colimit of affines and Proposition T.6.3.5.5, reduces further to a discrete E-infinity ring, identifies Fun*(X,S) with strictly Henselian Ind-étale A-algebras via Corollary 1.1.7, then proves the comparison with the groupoid of separable closures by comparing prime ideals, using the Henselization construction, full faithfulness, and essential surjectivity of the functor theta. This is the main point-description result of the subsection rather than a title-based selection.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Comparison of GPt(X) with the Kan complex of points of the underlying infinity-topos by affine reduction, discrete reduction, Henselization, and the groupoid C_0 of strictly Henselian Ind-étale algebras.
